blocks.text: David convenes Israel's full leadership—princes of the tribes, military captains, administrators, and officials—in Jerusalem for a crucial national assembly. This gathering provides the setting for David's address regarding the temple project and succession. David's role, though he will not build the temple himself, has been extensive and foundational. He has systematically prepared materials and architectural plans for Solomon's temple construction, organized the essential personnel required for the work including priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers, and treasurers, and mobilized public support for the monumental project ahead.
